sqlMap.select: SELECT 'KEPXXSBUSERAUTHTOKEN'||USER_ID AS MESSAGEID, 'GET_TOKEN' AS SIGNAL, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS REQUESTTIME, B.FND_REGNO AS SENDCOMREGNO, CASE WHEN B.FND_REGNO = '1078185880' AND #OP_TYPE# ='0' THEN '019B0F662C4A4901B15BFCEA12E339B0' WHEN B.FND_REGNO = '1078185880' AND #OP_TYPE# ='2' THEN '35D86AD157A74D40B50EDA2FB20879D8' WHEN B.FND_REGNO = '1358551796' AND #OP_TYPE# ='0' THEN '' WHEN B.FND_REGNO = '1358551796' AND #OP_TYPE# ='2' THEN '8D67B99656BA48DCA04325D71459AB8C' WHEN B.FND_REGNO = '1138523209' AND #OP_TYPE# ='0' THEN '' WHEN B.FND_REGNO = '1138523209' AND #OP_TYPE# ='2' THEN '' END AS AUTHCODE, B.SMART_ID AS SBID, 'Z' AS EXPIRATIONDATECODE, '' AS EXPIRATIONDATE, B.FND_USER FROM ICOMLUSR A, XXSB_DTI_SM_USER B WHERE A.COM_CODE='KRKORE0001' AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.OFFICE_YN IS NULL AND A.USER_ID = B.FND_USER AND B.AUTHTOKEN IS NULL
sqlMap.update: UPDATE XXSB_DTI_SM_USER A SET A.AUTHTOKEN = #AUTH_TOKEN# WHERE A.FND_USER = #FND_USER# AND A.FND_REGNO = #SENDCOMREGNO#
